Manoj Bajpayee Thriller 'Gajab Raat' Set for OTT Release

The thriller movie 'Gajab Raat', starring Manoj Bajpayee and Nushhratt Bharuccha, is scheduled for release on Over-The-Top (OTT) platforms. The film is among several new releases planned for the week of October 19-25.
